meta.evidence_status: PROPOSED DESIGN (dimensions from endcap/optimise.py; part masses CALC and ASSUMPTION); not built
conflicts: Proposed compact packaging: the end-cap spans z 151-175 mm behind the Rev H cell (z 101-149.5, unchanged); the Rev H handle shell ends at z 151 and the pen grows from 170 to 175 mm (Rev J limit). The USB-C side port moves from z 150-153.5 to z 147-150.5, beside the cell's rear end.

The study simulated the slug centre at z 152.5 mm (a 45 mm end-cap at z 130-175, which leaves the 48.5 mm cell no room); the compact packaging puts it at z 162 mm. See 'packaging_check' for the effect.
meta.axes: z along the pen axis from the ball tip (z = 0) toward the back; x in the tilt plane, positive away from the paper; y sideways
meta.optional_note: every end-cap part is marked optional: the end-cap is a module that replaces the Rev H rear cap and rear module; whether it is standard is the lead's decision (see the doc's proposed decision)
meta.moves_with_note: 'inertial_mass' = the sliding reaction mass (as rm_mass in the Rev H layout); 'rotor' = spinning; 'gimbal' = tilts on the gimbal; 'handle' = fixed to the pen body
meta.packaging: compact (PROPOSED DESIGN): flexures nested inside the coil ring, end-cap z 151-175 mm, slug centre z 162 mm

components.label: End-cap shell
components.function: Closes the back of the pen and holds the reaction mass; 26 mm across, 24 mm long.

components.label: End-cap rear wall
components.function: Closes the rear of the end-cap.

components.label: End-cap driver board
components.function: Coil drivers and the slug's position sensor; talks to the main board.

components.label: Tungsten reaction mass
components.function: A heavy slug that the coils push sideways (up to +/-4.0 mm in two axes); its reaction steadies the pen and can pulse for cues.
components.part: tungsten heavy alloy, non-magnetic grade (INERMET class)

components.label: Flexure plate (front)
components.function: Spiral spring plate nested inside the coil ring (rim held by four tabs between the coils), joined to the slug by a short axle: lets it move sideways, centres it at about 5 Hz, stiff along the pen.

components.label: Flexure plate (rear)
components.function: Spiral spring plate nested inside the coil ring (rim held by four tabs between the coils), joined to the slug by a short axle: lets it move sideways, centres it at about 5 Hz, stiff along the pen.

components.label: Slug magnet
components.function: NdFeB tile on the slug; the facing coil pushes it sideways.

components.label: Drive coils (4, arc-shaped)
components.function: Four arc-shaped coils bonded to the bore, one per side (x+, x-, y+, y-): current through a coil pushes the facing slug magnet sideways. Drawn as one ring; the gaps between the coils hold the flexure tabs.
components.part: self-bonding magnet wire, IEC class 155, wound on an arc former (ASSUMPTION)

components.label: USB-C port and button (moved)
components.function: The Rev H side port, moved 3 mm forward beside the cell's rear end (the cell is 14.1 mm across, the port sits at the shell wall 9 mm off the axis).
